name: Expedia Group, Inc.
moat_justification: A real B2B platform (Expedia Partner Solutions, bookings +21% YoY in Q2 2026) and One Key loyalty driving direct traffic, but Expedia is the #2/#3 player: Booking Holdings is larger and more profitable with faster engagement growth, Airbnb owns the alt-accommodation brand, Google/AI agents control the top of the funnel, and core supply (chain hotels, air) is commoditized.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 6.6%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 20.55 vs 3-yr median 13.57 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Quality OTA with a sticky B2B platform, moat 5/10 — clears 15% easily on TTM numbers (23.3% weighted, IV $492 vs $272) but the TTM base rides merchant-float growth; on the conservative median base it doesn't clear (IV $249), so size it as a B, not an A.
tier_override_reason: Method range spans Tier C (median base $13.57/sh: weighted IRR 14.11%, IV@15 $249.37) to Tier A (TTM base $32.70/sh: 23.30%, $491.74). The TTM base embeds merchant-float working-capital inflow that scales with bookings growth and has not survived a full audited year; with WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD present, the verdict is sized to the conservative end per the standing rule.
moat_for: B2B platform (Expedia Partner Solutions) — sticky partner integrations; B2B gross bookings +21% YoY in Q2 2026
One Key unified loyalty (reported 168M+ members) drives direct/app traffic, cutting paid-search dependence
Scale two-sided supply network and US market leadership
Merchant-model traveler float is structural interest-free funding while bookings grow
moat_against: Booking Holdings larger, more profitable, engagement growing faster (Expedia MAU growth ~0% in Q2 2026 per Morgan Stanley)
Vrbo is #2 to Airbnb, whose brand is the alt-accommodation category default
Google gatekeeper at the top of the funnel; agentic-AI booking is a live disintermediation threat
Supply skews to commoditized chain hotels and air; suppliers push direct booking
